visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/10) for headers. Cards use flat solid backgrounds with 1px border and hover lift.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture and noise overlays.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for depth, high contrast borders.

grids.bento_grid: Grid layout with asymmetrical spans, dense for dashboards

layouts.header: Glassmorphism sticky header with z-50, solid bottom border.

motion.hover: Smooth color and transform transitions. MUST explicitly define hover text colors.

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard compliance. Explicit hover/focus states.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

components.general: Use Shadcn UI for logic, raw HTML/Tailwind for structural layout. Use sonner for toasts.
components.buttons: Sharp edges or pill-shaped with explicit hover states.

dept_crypto.description: Dark, moody, macro shot of a Bitcoin on top of gold nuggets, perfect for institutional crypto luxury.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure absolute NO transparent background under headers or overlays. Adhere strictly to the luxury corporate mood (dark tones with gold #C5A059 and crimson #991B1B). Do not use generic AI slop layouts. Avoid generic fonts for headings like Inter.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Add transitions only for specific interactive elements.
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
